summary: Kurmangaliyev et al. 2019 (eLife), single-cell 10x of FACS-sorted T4/T5 neurons from female optic lobes at 24 and 48 h APF (23G12-GAL4 > UAS-H2A::GFP), from GEO GSE126139 and the authors' per-cell cluster files on GEO. Not in the old FlyBase/SCEA load. 2 Samples / Assays (one library per stage), linked to the GAL4 insertion FBti0134091 via GENO has_genotype. Two Clusterings (one per stage), one Cluster per author cluster (8 per stage, each one T4/T5 subtype): 16, all mapped to FBbt with Hörmann 2020's type mappings (immature subtype terms at 24 h, mature at 48 h) and loaded. Summary expression as CPM from the GEO raw counts (17,483 genes x 6,631 cells; 39,484 cluster x gene rows with extent > 0.2).

decisions.decision: Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held).
Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's gene counts.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset.

Narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the tissue-specific FBbt term exact; hold clusters that could only be typed as cell or neuron (or stage-specific versions); load glia under a glial-cell term.

Licence CC-BY-4.0 (eLife). Not in the old FlyBase/SCEA load (FlyBase curated only genes for the paper); SCEA E-GEOD-126139 labels cells only 'mixed T4 and T5', so the authors' per-cell files on GEO are used.

As for Hörmann 2020: one Clustering per stage, one Cluster per author cluster (stage x subtype, from the authors' per-cell files GSM*_clust24/48.txt); cells the authors marked 'filtered' are left out.

Stages by the Bainbridge & Bownes FBdv definitions (24 h P6, 48 h P8); Sample tissue the dissected optic lobe: embryonic/larval optic lobe to the pupal stage, adult optic lobe from the pharate adult stage (as for Özel 2021 / Kurmangaliyev 2020). Female (methods).
Samples from a cross link the genetic entities: here the GAL4 insertion P{GMR23G12-GAL4}attP2 (FBti0134091); UAS-H2A::GFP (a gift from Pfeiffer and Rubin) is not identified in FlyBase, so not linked.

FBbt mappings shared with Hörmann 2020 (type_mapping.from): immature subtype terms at 24 h APF, mature at 48 h. The shared immature justification reworded to name Hörmann et al. 2020 as the source of the term definitions.
Samples from GEO: each GSM one sample with one 10x library (titles 'T4/T5 <n>h APF', no replicate number).
Clusters: build_clusters.py reads the authors' per-cell files; the per-stage clusters have no numbers, so the subtype label is the cluster id.

Expression from the GEO CellRanger matrices (raw UMI counts) combined side by side (combine_matrices.py), cell -> cluster from the memberships (the authors' labelled cells), CPM over each cell's own counts; level the mean CPM over expressing cells, extent the fraction expressing, rows kept with extent > 0.2; FlyBase 6.22 FBgn ids mapped to current FlyBase genes.
All 16 mapped clusters reviewed by the curator (mapping.tsv `reviewed`).
